instructions.name: activate_child_grant_privacy
docs: Finance grants a manager access only after the manager is added to the
parent grant's PER readers. This lets the manager verify parent revocation.

instructions.name: activate_privacy
docs: Make state private to Founder and Finance. The CPI and readiness flag
share a transaction: if the permission update fails, readiness stays false.

instructions.name: activate_request_privacy
docs: Founder onboards this requester to this company. The privacy CPI and
readiness flag are atomic; later private data writes require the flag.

instructions.name: agent_pay
docs: Agent cannot touch the main treasury; only its separate token float.

instructions.name: approve_payment
docs: Reserve this request against the current thirty-day budget.

instructions.name: configure_agent
docs: Founder chooses one allowed recipient and two hard caps for this agent.

instructions.name: configure_limits
docs: The first confidential mutation is impossible until privacy is active.
These limits are policy data only; this proof does not move USDC.

instructions.name: create_agent_shell
docs: Base shell: no spending amount or destination is published here.

instructions.name: create_grant_shell
docs: A public, zero-authority shell. The grant's recipient list and caps are
populated only after delegation and the PER privacy permission are live.

instructions.name: create_request_shell
docs: Public shell with no recipient or amount. The requester pays its rent.

instructions.name: create_snapshot_shell
docs: Public shell. It carries no balance before private access is active.

instructions.name: delegate_policy
docs: Submit on Solana base. Resolve the TEE validator from deployment config;
the resulting ER endpoint is discovered through the MagicBlock router.

instructions.name: delegate_request
docs: Base-layer delegation. The caller must be the requester PDA seed.

instructions.name: execute_payment
docs: One PER transaction enforces approval and budget, transfers USDC via
PDA-signed SPL CPI, and finalizes the request. CPI failure reverts state.

instructions.name: fund_agent_float
docs: Until agent delegation is implemented, only Founder allocates Agent float.

instructions.name: init_permission
docs: Run on the selected ER, then call activate_privacy before any limit is set.

instructions.name: init_request_permission
docs: ER-local permission. Call before adding a private recipient or amount.

instructions.name: initialize_company
docs: Base-layer creation writes only non-confidential membership and zero limits.
The extra lamports sponsor the ER-local permission account after delegation.

instructions.name: reclaim_agent_float
docs: Founder reclaims unspent float after revocation or rotation.

instructions.name: reject_payment
docs: Finance can reject a request and release its current-period reserve.

instructions.name: set_request_readers
docs: Founder updates a request's private readers when a delegated role is
revoked. The backend must apply this to every indexed affected request.

instructions.name: set_snapshot_readers
docs: Founder refreshes snapshot visibility after a Finance grant is revoked.

instructions.name: submit_payment
docs: Only the requester can populate the private amount and recipient.

instructions.name: sync_treasury_snapshot
docs: Finance copies the canonical company ATA amount into a PER-private view.
The slot lets clients distinguish a fresh observation from stale state.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer does not have this company permission

errors.name: InvalidGrant
errors.msg: Team grant does not match the requested authority

errors.name: InvalidScope
errors.msg: Team or branch scope is invalid

errors.name: TooManyMembers
errors.msg: A grant already has the maximum number of child readers

errors.name: DuplicateMember
errors.msg: A member already reads the parent grant

errors.name: InvalidFinance
errors.msg: Finance wallet cannot be the default address

errors.name: PrivacyNotActive
errors.msg: Private permission must be active before writing limits

errors.name: InvalidLimit
errors.msg: Limit must be positive and the agent cap cannot exceed it

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: Request is in the wrong state

errors.name: WrongTokenAccount
errors.msg: Expected the canonical company token account
